events.text: For the team survey, I choose vendor A. It costs less and its quality is good enough.
I am considering vendor B for the team survey, but I have not changed my choice yet.
B is my tentative preference after its quality trial; we still need approval. A remains our approved choice for now.
Approval is complete. We adopt B for the team survey instead of A because the trial showed better quality.

questions.text: Which vendor is adopted for Maya's team survey now, what changed, and why?

events.text: 社區課程的錄影平台先決定用 A，因為價格較低，畫質也夠用。
看過 B 的畫質後，我暫時比較想選 B，但還沒正式改決定；目前仍用 A。

questions.text: 社區課程目前正式選定哪個平台？B 的狀態是什麼？

events.text: For field notes, I choose A because it works fully offline.
I tested A: it requires a connection at startup. My offline assumption was wrong. I have not selected a replacement.

questions.text: What did Leo choose for field notes, and is its reason still reliable?

events.text: 我的展覽印刷選 A，因為價格較低。
我的展覽印刷也決定用 A，但理由是它的色彩品質比較好。這是我自己的專案，與小敏的決定無關。

questions.text: 小敏的展覽印刷目前選哪家？阿哲的選擇有改變她的決定嗎？

events.text: For our archive scanner, I choose A because the purchase price is lower.
We now adopt B for the archive scanner instead of A; B's scan quality passed the preservation test.
Minutes from May 10: we were considering B, but A was still the adopted scanner then.

questions.text: After all minutes were filed, which archive scanner is adopted now?

events.text: 這次社區導覽採用 B，因為它支援離線地圖，而且志工已熟悉操作。
B 的離線地圖其實不能用；這個理由作廢。但志工熟悉 B，導覽仍維持選 B，沒有改平台。

questions.text: 導覽現在用哪個平台？哪些原本理由還成立？

events.text: I select A for my clinic scheduling pilot because the support contract is cheaper.
For my separate clinic pilot, I have adopted B for its better uptime.
I looked at B too, but I am keeping A for my scheduling pilot.

questions.text: Has Rae switched her scheduling pilot to B?

events.text: 店內庫存系統決定用 A，價格划算、掃碼品質也夠。
B 的掃碼測試結果更好，先列為候選；我還沒有改決定。
現在正式把店內庫存系統從 A 改成 B，因為 B 在實測中漏掃較少。

questions.text: 店內庫存系統現在正式採用哪個？改變的依據是什麼？
